title: Convertidor de Emoji a Manga Bleach: Creador de Historia de Acción de 8 Paneles
prompt: Step 1: Select any 8 emojis. Step 2: Draw these into an 8-panel Bleach (Death God) style manga. Add dialogue bubbles and create an engaging, action-packed storyline. Output: One page of stylized manga with dynamic action scenes, dramatic angles, and Japanese manga aesthetics.
